title: How to Use Your 7-Day Condo Cancellation Right in Southwest Florida FL: 2026 Buyer's Guide
excerpt: Florida Statute 718.503(2) gives condo resale buyers 7 days, excluding Saturdays, Sundays, and legal holidays, to void the contract in writing after receiving the association's milestone inspection summary and structural integrity reserve study. The right ends at closing — so the clock is the whole game.
